hook: Ceva's new AI engine design claims double the work per square millimetre.
sections: NeuPro is an AI processor design that chip companies license.
Think of a songwriter selling a hit song to many singers, earning royalties every time it plays.
First, chip makers license the design. Second, they build it into their chips and pay royalties.
Before, adding AI meant designing an engine from scratch.
Now Ceva claims 2 times throughput per square millimetre, 50 percent better efficiency, and is moving into AI infrastructure. General availability is planned for Q2 2027.
Royalties arrive years later. Our judgment: watch Ceva. Not financial advice.
